verdict.rationale: RUN documents its own recurring automation: payroll can be put "on autopilot" with RUN & DONE, and pay is deposited automatically on payday. That is a scheduled recurring job, but it covers only payroll. Nothing shows users defining or scheduling their own jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling of arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, control over schedule cadence and triggers, programmatic or API-based scheduling, any docs on how recurrence is set up, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
